dict.string: Slim Cheddar is a very rare worker, he only appears when he wants too. Some say he walks 8 mile each morning...
Zombie Doc was found in the lab chewing a door, he's of a better use on the assembly line if you ask me !!
Michael Harbor is a very famous director. He has an explosive mind and work very fast!
The nemesis of Green Man, &RRed &RMan is infamous for his &Ynoise &Ypollution!
Even the mascot of &YLocos &YTornados’ &Yfamily is insane! &RLocos &RDel &RTacos tried to eat himself once.
&RUranium &RBandit breaks everything Uranium Boy builds! One day he wants to be &Yfeared &Yby &Yall.
Breaking News !: &RKenny &RCharter is now a worker you can recruit! He’ll ask for a break every five minutes so he can &Ymake &Ya &Ynews &Yreport.
